property_prediction.definition: Predicting material properties from structural and chemical features.
property_prediction.deviation: Simulated using a noise distribution over target values due to the abstract nature of the dataset.

structure_generation.definition: Designing novel material microstructures that meet specific target distributions.
structure_generation.deviation: Compared generated and target distributions directly.

autonomous_optimization.definition: Navigating complex synthesis parameter spaces to minimize defects and optimize material performance.
autonomous_optimization.deviation: Simulated using a gradient descent algorithm on a synthetic 2D objective function.
